SELECT 
    refund_id,
    requested_ts,
    completed_ts,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_ts - requested_ts))/3600 AS hours_to_complete,
    amount_inr
FROM payments.upi_refunds
WHERE requested_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND requested_ts < '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY hours_to_complete DESC;

SELECT r.refund_id, r.rrn, r.requested_ts, r.completed_ts, 
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.completed_ts - r.requested_ts))/3600 AS hours_to_complete,
       r.amount_inr,
       u.status, u.status_ts, u.initiated_ts
FROM payments.upi_refunds r
LEFT JOIN payments.psp_upi_report u ON r.rrn = u.rrn
WHERE r.requested_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND r.requested_ts < '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY hours_to_complete DESC;

WITH declined_upi AS (
  SELECT bill_id, attempt, ts
  FROM payments.pos_payments
  WHERE ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
    AND tender = 'UPI'
    AND till_status = 'declined'
),
retried AS (
  SELECT d.bill_id
  FROM declined_upi d
  JOIN payments.pos_payments p
    ON p.bill_id = d.bill_id
   AND p.attempt > d.attempt
   AND p.tender = 'UPI'
   AND p.ts >= '2026-06-01' AND p.ts < '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY d.bill_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS retried_count
FROM retried;
